Name: Grampa's Orchard
Author: QuanYin
Description:
[size=5][center][b]What the hay, Grampa left you a farm full of weeds, rocks, and dead trees?
What a disaster!

Never fear, he wasn't THAT short sighted.  He had a small orchard.
True, only one tree survived - but its a doozy!
[/b][/center][/size]

Grampa may have turned up toes and died, leaving you saddled with his rundown farm - but at least one tree from his orchard survived.  It's the one he grafted with 6 different kinds of fruit.  It's gone wild and devolved into more of a bush than an actual tree, but its still fruiting, lucky for you.

It will alternate bearing between two kinds of fruit in season, starting Day One.  That's right - Spring 1 year 1!

Spring:  Apricots and Cherries
Summer:  Peaches and Oranges
Fall:  Apples and Pomegranates

At least he wasn't a total jerk.  This'll help you survive while you clean up the mess.

Currently uses default sprites for berries while they're on the bush - red salmonberries in Spring and Summer, and the blue/black Blackberries in Fall.  In Winter it is using the Winterberry Sprite by ncarigon that comes with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792]Bush Bloom Mod[/url].

This has only been tested with the default Vanilla farm but it should work for any farm that has one or more berry bushes.[s]

[/s]Collisions between modded seasons of different fruit will be reconciled by the fruit with the greater chance of occurring.  For instance, vanilla fruiting periods have a 20% chance of occurring on any given bush. Whichever fruit/nut that has a higher probability will "win".  This is set in the config.json file.  See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792]Bush Bloom Mod[/url] for details on how to change config.json.

[s][size=4]Currently WILL NOT work with Automate.  Automate will just turn everything into Salmonberries in Spring and Summer, and Blackberries in Fall and Winter. [/size] No idea why.  Hopefully there'll be a fix for that.

[/s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792]Bush Bloom Mod[/url] has been updated to work with Automate now.

[s]Currently cannot have a fruiting period of less than 2 days.[/s]

You can now define a fruiting periods of a single day.

You can change anything in the content.json file by hand, see documentation for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15792]Bush Bloom Mod[/url] for which this is a content pack.  Make changes at your own risk.  On your own head be it!

[b][size=3]Plans for the future:
[/size][/b]
Specific sprites for each individual fruit when it's on the bush.  These are mostly done now (as of 4/2/2023) and will be uploaded soon after some additional testing.



[center][b][size=5][i]Like Grampa's Orchard?  Check out my other BBM content pack, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16027/]Bush League![/url]﻿  
[/i][/size][/b]
[size=3]Stardew Valley - Now with more nuts and berries!  Specially formulated not to collide with Grampa's Orchard.

DOES NOT WORK WITH AUTOMATE.
